stories.title: Expose per-turn cache metrics and prewarm stats in cockpit model panel
acceptanceCriteria: SessionContext exposes getLatestTurnHitRate() returning null with no snapshots and last-turn cacheRead/(cacheRead+cacheCreation) otherwise.
AgentLoop exposes getPrewarmStats() returning PrewarmCache hits, misses, and hitRate.
AgentLoop records turn cache snapshots from onStopReason usage instead of relying on TUI-only accounting.
CockpitSnapshot.model includes perTurnHitRate, prewarmHits, prewarmMisses, prewarmHitRate, and cacheDiagnostic fields.
ModelPanel renders per-turn cache hit rate and prewarm hit summary when provided.
Targeted context/cockpit tests pass.

stories.title: Auto-trigger cache diagnostics on low per-turn hit rate
acceptanceCriteria: AgentLoop stores a latest cache diagnostic message when latest turn hit rate is below 0.8.
AgentLoop clears the cache diagnostic when latest turn hit rate is at least 0.8 or unavailable.
CockpitSnapshot.model.cacheDiagnostic reads from AgentLoop.getCacheDiagnostic().
ModelPanel renders cacheDiagnostic visibly when it is non-null.
Existing TUI app-level cache diagnostic path is removed or made non-duplicating so turn cache is not double-counted.
Targeted loop/cockpit tests pass.

stories.title: Truncate oversized tool results with head and tail preservation
acceptanceCriteria: A new truncateToolResult(content, maxTokens) returns content unchanged when under budget.
truncateToolResult shortens oversized content and includes a truncated marker with removed character count.
truncateToolResult preserves the content head and tail.
executeToolUse applies truncation to normal tool results using compactThresholds(contextWindow).toolResultMaxTokens.
executeToolUse also applies truncation to the run_tests diagnosis early-return path.
Targeted truncation and tool-pipeline tests pass.

stories.title: Expand prewarm cache and make eviction LRU
acceptanceCriteria: PrewarmCache.get() refreshes access recency for live entries.
PrewarmCache.set() evicts the least recently used entry when maxEntries is exceeded.
AgentLoop default prewarm cache uses 60s TTL and 50 entries.
Prewarm tests cover LRU eviction and recency refresh behavior.
Targeted prewarm tests pass.

stories.title: Prewarm recently read files at turn start without async streaming churn
acceptanceCriteria: AgentLoop prewarms cache entries from recent successful read_file tool history at turn start.
Prewarm-from-history avoids recaching entries already present in PrewarmCache.
Implementation does not convert streaming text callbacks to async or introduce unawaited Promise.all behavior.
Tests verify recent read_file history populates prewarm cache for later read_file reuse.
Targeted prewarm/loop tests pass.
